interpretation.rootCause: The packaged ONNX Runtime Web script does not parse on WebView 83 (Unexpected token =). Native Android ONNX CPU inference succeeds on that same WebView and bypasses its Worker/WASM bootstrap. WebView 124 Worker boot reaches ready.
interpretation.accuracyLimit: This is a regression smoke test using an existing quartz image, not independent field accuracy or Kappa validation.
interpretation.networkLimit: Baseline run disabled Wi-Fi and mobile data, but emulated Ethernet and navigator.onLine remained active. It does not establish complete network disconnection.
interpretation.artifactLimit: Baseline Gradle cleanup uninstalled the app before screenshot and JSON pull. The complete JSON evidence is recovered from Logcat; screenshots were not preserved.
interpretation.nextVerification: Workflow now also lowers Ethernet links, asserts no IPv4/IPv6 default routes and navigator.onLine=false, and keeps test APKs installed long enough to pull evidence. This strengthened run is pending.
